trait_target.interpretation: Primary matcher diagnostic: compares automatic candidates only with curated shared/semantic TRAIT relations, which is the closest like-for-like internal target. Curated edges are still not an external gold standard.

all_curated_edges_context_only.interpretation: Context-only diagnostic. This mixes trait, mission-alignment, bestowed/divine-interaction relation modes and therefore must not be used as matcher accuracy.

warnings: Data-confidence mean is 87.71; rubric is high/saturated and must not be interpreted as probability or fine-grained ranking.
At least one relation reaches 100; this is a rubric ceiling, not metaphysical certainty.
Trait-evidence leaderboard has only 4 unique score levels; it is an evidence-class ranking, not a fine-grained continuous measure.
World-trait salience is available for only 9/25 profiles; missing mappings must remain missing rather than imputed.
note: Scores are deterministic research rubrics. They are uncalibrated and are not probabilities, holiness measures, or rankings of prophetic worth.
